spec: OCP Data Center Facility (DCF) Interoperability & Governance

OCP-DCF-001.clause: OCP DCF §3.1 Derived Module Port Compatibility
OCP-DCF-001.title: 衍生模块与 OCP 标准单元端口签名兼容性
OCP-DCF-001.quote: Any vendor or project cell declaring an ocp_base_unit must preserve compatible external port kinds and directions.

OCP-DCF-002.clause: OCP DCF §5.1 Facility PUE Target & Residual Air Heat Budget
OCP-DCF-002.title: 设施能效目标（PUE）与残余风冷热负荷预算
OCP-DCF-002.quote: Liquid-cooled OCP facilities must declare an enforceable PUE envelope (<= 1.35) and explicit residual air heat rejection capacity.

OCP-DCF-003.title: 数据来源状态声明与越界禁止静默通过治理
OCP-DCF-003.quote: All specifications and Liberty tables must declare explicit provenance state; missing or out-of-envelope values yield indeterminate.
